integrity: The all-order proof consists of a parity obstruction, a three-residue-class obstruction, six explicit local matching tiles, and one Hamiltonian-cycle construction. Finite checks are corroborative rather than a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats labeled even-seat circular matchings with length multiset supported on 1,2,3, n>=3, and does not enumerate matchings or address lengths greater than three. Some two-length and invertible-distance subcases were previously known. Priority beyond the inspected literature remains subject to independent scrutiny.
title: Three-distance seating matchings: a complete cyclic classification
